debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought stochastic/stochRSI conditions, weak ADX trend strength (18.49), below-average volume, severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, rising USD, flat yield curve), high earnings risk in 28 days, and zero fundamental/smart money support make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup.
